description:
Give the validated newtype the `IssueId` name and remove the temporary alias bridge, so the compiler enforces issue identity and stored ids decode strictly.

## Background

Issue identity has been adopted through `crate::domain::identity::IssueId`, a temporary alias for `String`, plus an `IssueIdStaging` trait that gives `String` a `short_id()`. The validated newtype sits in the same module under a staging name. Each production family and each test suite has been retyped to the alias using only the newtype's trait set, so the remaining residue is where strings become ids: the identity module itself, the identifier authority in `repository_state/mutation.rs` (`IdAuthority::uuid_at`, `:149-162`), which wraps generated UUIDs, record decoding in the JSON and memory backends, and lease-record decoding in `storage/claim_coordinator.rs`. The memory backend builds record paths with `.expect` (`storage/memory.rs:338-339`), which panics on a non-canonical id. Lease records in this checkout's machine-local claims log already name issues by full id. Interim call-site prefix parses that once bridged the resolver's retyping have been replaced by parsing at the CLI and server entry points.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain::identity::IssueId` is the validated newtype; the `String` alias, the staging name and the `IssueIdStaging` trait no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: No production code builds an `IssueId` from a string except record decoding, prefix resolution and the identifier authority.
- [hard] REQ-03: Decoding an issue record whose id or dependency is non-canonical fails with an error naming the record path, and a storage test shows it.
- [hard] REQ-04: Resolving a non-canonical id against the memory backend returns its not-found error, where it used to panic, and a storage test shows it.
- [hard] REQ-05: A lease record whose issue id is not canonical fails to decode with an error naming the record.
- [hard] REQ-06: No production `IssueIdPrefix` parse remains outside the CLI and server entry points and the item-address decoder, and the only production `resolve_issue_id` call under `commands/` is the item-address resolution in `commands/item.rs`.
- [hard] REQ-07: Issue, index and event JSON and current-format gate-run JSON in this repository load and re-serialize byte-identically, and every other stored gate-run record decodes and reproduces its id fields.

## Notes

No compatibility reader is added for non-canonical stored ids (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`).
title: IssueId becomes the validated newtype
